kañjiya.p: [Kañji+iya] (na) CL=7 [Kañjito nibbattaṃ kañjiyaṃ āranālaṃ, yaṃbilaṅgantipi vuccati. Ma, ṭī, 2. 43. Aṃ, ṭī, 2. 1. Ka+añjiya. Kenajalena añjiyamabhibyattaṃ assa kañjiyaṃ. Dhāna, ṭī. 460.] (1) A vinegar that is made by fermenting Nipa palm sap. (2) A vinegar that is fermenting with water in which rice has been washed. See also - Acchakañjī.
a: ကဉ္ဇိတော နိဗ္ဗတ္တံ ကဉ္ဇိယံ အာရနာလံ၊ ယံဗိလင်္ဂန္တိပိ ဝုစ္စတိ။ မ၊ ဋီ၊ ၂။ ၎၃။ အံ၊ ဋီ၊ ၂။ ၁။ က+အဉ္ဇိယ။ ကေနဇလေန အဉ္ဇိယမဘိဗျတ္တံ အဿ ကဉ္ဇိယံ။ ဓာန်၊ ဋီ။ ၎၆ဝ။] (၁)ပအုံးရည်၊ ပုန်းရည်။(၂)ဆန်ဆေးရည်။ အစ္ဆကဉ္ဇီ-လည်းကြည့်။

kañji.p: [Ka+jana+i] (thī) CL=7 (1) (A) A kind of vinegar made by fermenting nipa palm sap. (B) A kind of vinegar made with water in which rice has been washed. (C) A resin that is like a kind of vinegar made by fermenting nipa palm sap.  Rice puree slurry. See - Kañjikapiṭṭhakhaliallika. (2) Rice porridge.
